failure_summary.description: Calls used an incorrect parameter or value representation, omitted required name/value structure, or produced malformed JSON.
An explicit requested outcome was missed while an extra or overlapping call was added.
A less suitable operation or a non-exact tool identifier was used.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already covered by the skill’s outcome checklist, smallest-complete-call-set rule, endpoint-specific schema requirements, exact tool-name validation, and final JSON audit. Repeating those rules would not address a demonstrated policy gap.
